# Generated by `cd proto && buf generate` — never hand-edit.

The relative `out=` and `base=` paths in `buf.gen.yaml` only resolve from
`proto/`, so that is where the command must be run.

`openapi.yaml` here is the RAW generator output. It is not the published
document: `services/cmd/openapi-postprocess` prunes it to the methods
annotated `VISIBILITY_PUBLIC` and corrects the `info` block before writing
`web/public/openapi.json`. Run the whole pipeline with `make openapi`.
